source_text: Mortui enim sumus peccato, quomodo adhuc vivemus in illo? Exhibete membra vestra arma iustitiae Deo. Gloria Deo. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: For we have died to sin; how shall we still live in it? Present your members as weapons of righteousness to God. Glory to God. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[How can we who died to sin still live in it? >> Bible:Romans 6:2]]. [[Present your members to God as instruments for righteousness >> Bible:Romans 6:13]]. Glory to God. Amen.
notes: True OET; no Scheck FOTC Romans.
